title: p2y5.2: Rust gateway: internet-to-mesh IPv6 forwarding path
description: lichen-gateway does not receive packets from upstream and forward them to mesh nodes. Implement: read from backhaul tun interface, look up destination in RPL routing table, SCHC-compress, sign with link-layer key, transmit via LoRa L2. Requires: tun read loop, routing table lookup, source routing header insertion.
